name: The Hatchery
tagline: A game-like virtual incubator where AI crews build your startup idea in front of you.

awards: Build an AI agent with Cohere

problem: Good ideas stall without technical or marketing skills.
solution: A 3D lobby where crews of agents for software and marketing work on your idea in real time, with an embedded IDE.
demo_moment: Team-described: drop in an idea and watch the AI crew build it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Build an AI agent with Cohere” among 134 submissions.
Makes multi-agent work visible as a game.

lessons: Visualising agents as characters makes orchestration legible.
